title: Red State
review: There's some very lazy storytelling here. Imagine if {Heretic} and {Green Room} were written and directed by Kevin Smith, instead of any real professionals. The pastor is good, and I liked cousin Greg's rat tail. Also John Goodman shows up half way through as a larger-than-life character, which is the best possible way to deploy him in any film. Any momentum it builds up is lost during a long and monotonous gun fight, unravelling the story and ending with a whimper. It's just not that effective as a horror movie, and also fairly humourless.
